method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 醒来时天已黑，发现自己在浴室地板上睡了过去。
facts.anchor: Somehow, she fell asleep on the bathroom floor.

facts.fact: 她看手机确认：约下午四点睡着，现在已过九点。
facts.anchor: It was maybe four in the afternoon when she drifted off and now it’s—she checks her phone—after nine.

facts.fact: 她在冰箱和炉子间来回几次让身体活动开，炒了洋葱、甜椒和 pound 火鸡肉末。
facts.anchor: She chops an onion and two bell peppers while browning a pound of ground turkey.

facts.fact: 她靠着台面吃饭，怕一坐下就再也站不起来。
facts.anchor: She eats leaning against the counter because she’s afraid if she sits down she won’t get back up again.

facts.fact: Wendy 发来短信：与心理医生会面顺利，J 似乎喜欢她。
facts.anchor: Meeting with psych went good. J seemed to like her. Call tomorrow if you get time.

facts.fact: Hattie 给短信点了赞，说早上再联系 Wendy。
facts.anchor: Hattie likes the message and says she’ll touch base with her in the morning.

facts.fact: 她去客厅把火生起来，海风把窗户压得弯曲，但窗户挺住了。
facts.anchor: Once the fire’s going she studies it as it lights up the stove’s interior.

facts.fact: 她想起治疗师的话：你永远不会真正无助，去做你能做的事。
facts.anchor: Look for what you can do. There’s always something.

facts.fact: 她几乎立刻想到了自己能做什么。
facts.anchor: It comes to her almost at once.
